reason: While the passage does describe some people attempting to gather manna on the seventh day in violation of the given instruction, this demonstrates disobedience rather than antagonism toward Moses. The text shows no hostile confrontation between the people and their leader. Instead, it presents corrective instruction from the Lord, after which 'the people rested on the seventh day,' indicating ultimate compliance. Antagonism implies hostility and opposition to the leader personally, whereas this passage only shows a failure to obey instructions, followed by eventual obedience. The people do not challenge, resist, or oppose Moses directly.
